meta.name: ecommerce-seo
meta.description: E-commerce SEO audit for online stores (WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento, custom). Covers category / product listing pages (PLP), product detail pages (PDP), faceted navigation and its crawl-budget and duplicate-content traps, pagination, canonicals for variants and filters, out-of-stock / discontinued products, internal linking and breadcrumbs, and Product / Offer / Review / AggregateRating / BreadcrumbList structured data. Use whenever the user runs an online store and asks about product or category page SEO, filter URLs being indexed, product rich results, or thin/duplicate product pages. Trigger on: "e-commerce SEO", "ecommerce SEO", "product page SEO", "category page SEO", "WooCommerce SEO", "Shopify SEO", "faceted navigation", "filter URLs in Google", "product schema", "rich snippets for products", "out of stock SEO", "duplicate product pages". For a single URL use /seo-page; for full-site use /seo-analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查网店商品页与分类页在搜索里的问题,并给出排名提升的具体修复方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营网店,商品页或分类页在搜索结果里表现不佳
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run an online store and your product or category pages underperform in search

howto.what: 它审查网店的分类页、商品页和筛选链接,找出被浪费的抓取预算、重复或过薄的页面、缺失的商品结构化数据,并给出按优先级排序的修复清单(含电商 SEO 评分和 30 天计划)。
howto.when: 当店主询问商品页或分类页 SEO、筛选 URL 被收录、商品富媒体结果等问题,或提到「e-commerce SEO」等关键词时触发。单个 URL 用 /seo-page,整站用 /seo-analysis。

say.text: 帮我审一下这家店的电商 SEO,重点看筛选 URL 是否被收录。
say.note: 会给出抓取预算泄漏估计和修复清单。

say.text: 我这家 Shopify 店的商品变体 canonical 设对了吗?
say.note: 检查变体产生的近似重复 URL。

say.text: 商品缺货或停产时,该保留页面还是 404?
say.note: 给出保留并标注库存的建议。

howto.what_en: It audits an online store's category and product pages, filter URLs and structured data, spotting wasted crawl budget, thin or duplicate pages and missing rich results, then returns a prioritized fix plan with a score.
howto.when_en: Use when a store owner asks about product or category page SEO, indexed filter URLs, product rich results, or thin/duplicate pages. Single URL: /seo-page; full site: /seo-analysis.

say_en.text: Audit the e-commerce SEO of my store, focusing on indexed filter URLs.
say_en.note: Returns a crawl-budget leak estimate and fix plan.

say_en.text: Are the canonicals right on my Shopify product variants?
Should an out-of-stock product page be kept or 404'd?
say_en.note: Explains keeping it and marking availability.
